## What BNR intends to monitor

Subject to final approval, the measures are expected to describe areas such as:

- registry or service coverage;
- recorded diabetes prevalence;
- completion of key monitoring checks;
- glycaemic control 

## What the completed page will specify

| Element | Required detail |
|---|---|
| Measure | Plain-language question and stable name |
| Numerator | People or records meeting the stated condition |
| Denominator | Clearly defined eligible population |
| Time rule | Measurement window and reporting period |
| Clinical rule | Test, diagnosis, treatment or threshold definition |
| Exclusions | Missing, ineligible or not-applicable records |
| Interpretation | Intended use and important limitations |

## Publication status

No number should be interpreted as a routine BNR diabetes measure until its definition, source, quality checks and disclosure rules have been approved and added here.
